job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed mtp-wfc_tok-hard-e829cb457-r2-tc-cx (dsfd_wfc_tok_hard, RTL e829cb457, snapshot of 4 drifted files): same RTL, outline 162.0x151.2, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Codex:mtp-rom/wfc_hard

benches.name: exact_and_epoch_mutant
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_tok_hard_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_tok_hard_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/dsrom_wfc_token_hard_gate.py --out {RUN}/bench
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the e829cb457 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_tok_hard_m5/src]

benches.name: negative_epoch
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_1; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_tok_hard_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_tok_hard_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { mkdir -p {RUN}/negative && iverilog -g2012 -s tb_mtp_rom_tok_hard -DOT_WFCTOK_MUT_NOEPOCH -o {RUN}/negative/sim.vvp rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_tok.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/ot_dsrom_wfc_tok_r3.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/mtp/tb/tb_mtp_rom_tok_hard.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/negative/sim.vvp > {RUN}/negative/run.log && python3 -c "import pathlib,sys;p=pathlib.Path('{RUN}/negative/run.log').read_text();assert 'MTP_TOK_HARD FAIL read=277' in p;print('WFC_TOKEN_HARD_NEGATIVE FAIL_AS_REQUIRED');sys.exit(1)"
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the e829cb457 snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_wfc_tok_hard_m5/src]
